field_meaning.hi: HTML में दूसरा पेज जोड़ने वाला टैग

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi description says 'HTML में दूसरा पेज जोड़ने वाला टैग' (Tag in HTML that connects to another page). This is correct for the <a> tag. However, 'Link' is also a general term. The kind is 'tag', which is specific. This is acceptable.
